newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIA CLEARS ANZ CASH REWARDS PLAN.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIA CLEARS ANZ CASH REWARDS PLAN.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Wednesday the government had approved the linking of the bank's new ANZ Gold MasterCard to its recently launched private health insurance scheme.
The Federal Department of Health and Family Services had raised concerns that the rewards programme would only benefit a select group of society since not everyone qualified for a gold card.
Cardholders paying their ANZ Health Insurance premiums with the credit card would receive cash rewards, based on spending, credited to the card account and available for any purpose.
The bank said it would extend the programme to an existing card later this year.

"To make the coverage of the cash rewards programme as widespread as possible, ANZ will be enhancing its existing Free Days MasterCard to offer a similar cash rewards programme for cardholders who pay for their ANZ Health Insurance premiums with their card," Charles Carbonaro, chief general manager of ANZ's card division, said in a statement.
The Free Days MasterCard will have a lower cash reward limit and a lower fee than the Gold MasterCard, ANZ said.
-- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800 Wednesday, 11 June 1997 03:44:42 ENDS nSYD30072
